scope: Different-author, read-only audit of the sealed M1856 diagnostic-only source package. The audit verified the M1854/M1845 consumed-failure and no-retry boundary, exact M1811 K8 mapped netlist, exact K8/case0 filelist, public and endpoint per-bit case-equality localization, observation-only internal taps in the current source, one-compile/one-simulation budget, zero UCLI/SAIF/PTPX, namespace freshness, dual-runtime official suites, and synchronized-source-inventory mutations. No VCS, simv, UCLI, SAIF, PTPX, DC, PT, Formality, license query, GPU, remote work, attempt, result, release, source mutation, predecessor mutation, docs/359 mutation, ucli.key access, commit, or push was performed.
verdict: FAIL CLOSED. The exact M1856 runner and TB are currently scoped correctly and the official checker plus 26 tests pass on CPython 3.6 and 3.12. However, the checker accepts 12 of 18 synchronized-inventory semantic mutations on both runtimes. Material escapes remove the actual main-path authority call, retarget namespaces, remove either freshness check and both locks/collision protection, erase the result claim boundary, remove the first-X/Z stop, or disconnect the emitted X/Z value. The authority-order check is especially ineffective because text.index('verify_authority()') can match the function definition after the main call is removed. Therefore the source package cannot authorize an M1858 diagnostic launch release. A successor source must bind exact namespace constants and main-path call/order/cardinality semantics, per-branch stop/token semantics, and the complete exact_diagnostic_identity, then reject these synchronized mutations on both runtimes.

milestone_label_collision.note: The repeated integer label is a human-readability defect only. Exact directory names, release filenames, status tokens, and M1856_EXPECTED_* authority pins are disjoint. It does not cause this FAIL_CLOSED verdict and does not authorize either flow.

findings.finding: The M1856 semantic checker is not fail-closed for its own promised authority, namespace/freshness, locking, claim-boundary, and first-X/Z-stop semantics. Twelve synchronized-source-inventory mutations escape on both CPython runtimes.
findings.impact: A future source edit can remain green while bypassing the reviewed launch authority, unique namespace/freshness protocol, concurrency guard, or diagnostic token/stop boundary. The current exact source appears well-scoped, but the package cannot support an audited M1858 release under the project's mutation-resilient admission standard.
findings.minimal_fix: Create an additive successor source. Make the checker bind exact ATTEMPT/RESULT/FAILURE/WORK/STAGE/FAIL_STAGE/QUEUE/LOCAL_LOCK constants; exact main-path call cardinalities and order for verify_authority, both namespaces_fresh calls, both locks, collision gates, attempt creation, compile, simulation, parser, and publication; exact claim-boundary publication; four first-nonbinary branches with their matching observed values and one finish each; and every exact_diagnostic_identity field. Add synchronized-inventory tests for all twelve escapes on CPython 3.6 and 3.12. Do not create M1858 from M1856.
